zh.title: 國防部偵獲中共7軍艦與6公務船活動 24小時內未見共機
zh.summary: 國防部指出台海周邊24小時內偵獲中共7艘軍艦與6艘公務船，未發現共機活動。
body: 中華民國國防部於8月29日表示，自8月28日上午6時至29日上午6時止，在台灣海峽周邊空域與海域共偵獲7艘中共軍艦以及6艘公務船持續活動。國軍已運用任務機、任務艦及岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與應處。
國防部說明，在此24小時期間內未偵獲任何中共軍機活動，因此並未提供相關航跡圖。
根據國防部逐日發布的統計紀錄，國軍於8月23日上午9時5分至10時50分在台灣海峽空域偵獲2架次中共主戰機後，截至29日上午6時為止，均未再發現共機在台海周邊空域進行活動。

en.title: Taiwan Defense Ministry Tracks 7 PLA Warships and 6 Official Vessels Around Strait
en.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry detected seven Chinese warships and six official vessels around the Taiwan Strait.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense stated on August 29 that it detected seven Chinese naval vessels and six official ships operating in the waters around Taiwan between 06:00 on August 28 and 06:00 on August 29. The armed forces monitored the situation using aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems.
The defense ministry noted that no Chinese military aircraft were detected during the 24-hour monitoring period, and therefore no flight track map was provided.

According to daily tracking records from the ministry, Taiwan's military last detected two Chinese main fighter aircraft in the Taiwan Strait airspace between 09:05 and 10:50 on August 23, with no further military aircraft activity recorded through 06:00 on August 29.
